name: LeetCode Theory Guide
description: Theory/background guide for an existing LeetCode practice problem (never the solution): a short auto-approved plan resolves the problem directory, a writer creates one Vietnamese theory.md there (concepts, C knowledge, collapsed 3-rung hint ladder, pitfalls, similar problems, verified links only), and an independent auditor checks no-solution, hint, link and fact rules, sending it back on failure. Task: the problem id, slug, title or path, e.g. 217 or contains-duplicate.

nodes.label: Resolve problem (plan)
nodes.goal: Plan only (no edits). First DO the resolution now: list the directories under c/ and cpp/ and find the ONE existing problem directory the task names, per skill lc-theory-guide section 1, then read its notes.md and test.c (not solution.c). The plan must name the concrete directory (e.g. c/hash/0217_contains-duplicate), the file it will write there (theory.md), the id, title and slug, the 2-4 concepts, the mandatory C pitfalls of each concept (skill section 3) and the links (from skill section 4 only) the guide will cover. If no single directory matches, say so and plan no write. Scope: exactly one entry, the existing problem directory you resolved, written literally (e.g. c/hash/0217_contains-duplicate), never '.' and never a file. Checks: list ONLY the literal command `git diff --check`; never list tools/build_test.py, because the user's solution may be unfinished and its result is irrelevant to the guide.

nodes.label: Auto-approve writing theory.md
nodes.purpose: Approved automatically: the writer may create or replace only theory.md in the resolved problem directory

nodes.label: Write theory.md
nodes.goal: Write the planned Vietnamese theory guide to theory.md in the resolved problem directory, in the exact format of skill lc-theory-guide section 3: complexity budget from the constraints, 2-4 background concepts explained in general terms, C knowledge including the mandatory pitfalls of every concept named, a 3-rung hint ladder in collapsed details blocks, pitfalls as questions, similar problems, general links. Every number and complexity as inline code, never LaTeX or bare parentheses. No solution code, pseudo-code or algorithm steps; links only from skill section 4 or exact LeetCode problem pages. Keep Vietnamese diacritics intact (UTF-8). Replace theory.md if it exists; change no other file. Run the planned check.

nodes.label: Guide audit
criteria: only theory.md in the resolved problem directory was created or changed; nothing else
R1 no solution code, pseudo-code, algorithm steps or how-to-apply recipe anywhere
R2 at most three hint rungs, each in its own collapsed details block, gentlest first, rung 3 names at most a concept family
R5 facts correct: data-structure complexities, constraints match notes.md, title and id match
every URL is listed in skill lc-theory-guide section 4 or is the matching LeetCode problem page (judge by reading; inability to open URLs is not a failure)
C section covers the mandatory pitfalls of every concept named in section 2
numbers and complexities written as inline code, no LaTeX or bare parentheses
all sections of the skill format present and written in Vietnamese
